sn22.122:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-Koṭṭhito Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti Isipatane Migadāye || || 2-3
sn22.122:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhito sāyaṇhasamayam paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || pa || etad avoca || ||
sn22.122:1.3: Sīlavatāvuso Sāriputta bhikkhunākatame dhammā yoniso manasi kattabbāti || || 4
sn22.122:1.4: Sīlāvatāvuso Koṭṭhita bhikkhunā pañcupādānakkhandā aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato yoniso manasi kattabbā || || 5
sn22.122:1.7: Sīlavatāvuso Koṭṭhita bhikkhunā ime pañcupādānakkhandhā aniccato dukkhato || pe || anattato yoniso manasi kattabbā || || 6
sn22.122:1.8: Ṭhānaṃ kho panetam āvuso vijjati || yaṃ sīlavā bhikkhu ime pañcupādānakkhandhe aniccato dukkhato || pe || anattato yoniso manasi karonto sotāpattiphalam sacchikareyyāti || || 7
sn22.122:2.1: Sotāpannena panāvūso Sāriputta bhikkhunā katame dhammā yoniso manasikattabbāti || || 8
sn22.122:2.2: Sotāpannena pi kho āvuso Koṭṭhita bhikkhunā ime pañcupādānakkhandhā aniccato || pe || anattato manasi kattabbā || || 9
sn22.122:2.3: Ṭhānaṃ kho panetam āvuso vijjati || yaṃ sotāpanno bhikkhu ime pañcupādānakkhandhe aniccato || pe || anattato yoniso manasi karonto sakadāgāmiphalaṃ sacchikareyyāti || || 10
sn22.122:3.1: Sakadāgāminā panāvuso Sāriputta bhikkhunā katame ca dhammā yoniso kattabbāti || || 11
sn22.122:3.2: Sakadāgāminā pi kho āvuso Koṭṭhita bhikkhunā ime pañcupādānakkhandhā aniccato || pe || anattato manasi kattabbā || || 12
sn22.122:3.3: Ṭhānaṃ kho panetam āvuso vijjati || yaṃ sakadāgāmi bhikkhu pañcupādānakkhandhe aniccato || pe || anattato yoniso manasi karonto anāgāmiphalaṃ sacchikareyyāti || || 13
sn22.122:4.1: Anāgāminā panāvuso Sāriputta bhikkhunā katame dhammā yoniso manasi kattabbā ti || || 14
sn22.122:4.2: Anāgāminā pi kho āvuso Koṭṭhita bhikkhunā ime pañcupādānakkhandhā aniccato || pe || anattato yoniso manasi kattabbā || || 15
sn22.122:4.3: Ṭhānaṃ kho panetam āvuso vijjati || yam anāgāmi bhikkhu ime pañcupādānakkhandhe aniccato || pe || anattato yoniso manasi karonto
